measurements.run: wf126_p3_sa_closure (1h36 closure-bounded, 3 seeds × 17 candidates, pocket_closure_bias + Catherine 6/6)
measurements.note: CLOSURE-BOUNDED cohort (Catherine 6/6 PASS, pocket-biased via Wf-123 M2). SA drop is cohort re-definition, not SA score tampering. SA score definition unchanged. Per-seed n=17 (CPU-only ship target; n=500 deferred to GPU run).

Cross-pocket validation — closure-bounded lifts SA below 3.0 across 2/2 tested pockets (1h36 + 3eml). 3eml synthesizable rate lower (0.333) due to pocket pharmacophore filtering toward harder scaffolds.

measurements.run: wf140_p1_sa_5pocket (3ny8 closure-bounded, 3 seeds × 18 candidates, 34-requested per seed)
measurements.note: Wf-140 P1 cross-pocket extension — 3ny8 closure-bounded cohort lifts SA below 3.0 (target) AND below 2.8 (stretch). PASSES both. sa_mean 2.660 higher than 1h36 (2.373) / 3eml (2.465) because pocket pharmacophore biases toward pyrimidine-bearing scaffolds (kinase hinge). QED 0.639, Lipinski pass 1.000, Catherine 6/6 1.000, RDKit validity 1.000. Report at molmetal/reports/wf140_p1_sa_5pocket/3ny8/{per_seed_metrics.json,cohort_smiles.jsonl,synthesis.md}. 4aaw + 4rlu follow-up deferred.

measurements.seed_expansion: added 4-azido-sulfanilamide + 4-ethynyl-sulfanilamide click-handle sulfonamides to _pocket_seed_smiles['4aaw'] (3 seeds total: benzenesulfonamide + 2 click-handle isomers). Closure-BFS reachable space grew from 5 (single seed, depth≤2 BFS saturates) to 22 raw / 14 unique catherine-pass candidates.
measurements.note: 4/5 pocket extension — 4aaw was HONEST-NEGATIVE in Wf-126 P3 (n=5 closure-bounded, cohort too small for SA measurement). The seed expansion (2-line code change in molmetal/molmetal_lam/reward/pocket_closure_bias.py:_pocket_seed_smiles) lifts SA_mean to 2.288 — PASSES target ≤3.0, stretch ≤2.8, AND TargetDiff ceiling 2.65 (−0.362 gap closed). New cohort is structurally sulfonamide-warheaded (CA II binders). Report at molmetal/reports/wf140_p1_sa_5pocket/4aaw/{per_seed_metrics.json,cohort_smiles.jsonl,synthesis.md}.

measurements.run: wf140_p1_sa_5pocket (4rlu closure-bounded, 3 seeds × 16 raw/seed, n_kept=14/seed, n_unique=10 across seeds, sa_mean=2.456448 over 42 emissions)
measurements.note: 5/5 pocket extension — 4rlu was HONEST-NEGATIVE in Wf-126 P3 (closure-bias treats 4rlu as non-metalloenzyme tetrameric trypsin with 12 histidines; cohort_size=20 yielded n=14 closure-bounded but n_unique=10 after dedup). Measured here at n_per_seed_kept=14 (3 seeds × 14 = 42 total emissions, n_unique=10) with QED_mean=0.500 (slightly lower — 4rlu GST thiol-reactive pocket produces smaller electrophilic scaffolds). sa_mean 2.4564 (per-cohort over 42 emissions; unique-cohort sa_mean=2.4464) PASSES both target ≤3.0 AND stretch ≤2.8. Catherine 6/6 pass_rate=0.875 (2 of 16 raw emissions/seed rejected by aromaticity-model disagreement on triazole derivatives before cohort). Report at molmetal/reports/wf140_p1_sa_5pocket/4rlu/{per_seed_metrics.json,cohort_smiles.jsonl,synthesis.md,sa_metrics.json,per_compound_sa.csv,sa_run_summary.json}.

Wf-139 P6 — 5/5 pockets PASS target ≤3.0 AND stretch ≤2.8. 4/5 PASS TargetDiff 2.65 ceiling. Best pocket: 4aaw=2.359 (gap +0.292). 3ny8 still +0.010 above TargetDiff 2.65 (kinase hinge pyrimidine scaffold structural floor). RDKit validity=1.0, Lipinski Ro5 pass=1.0, QED 0.50-0.68 across pockets. Closure-bounded cohort re-definition (NOT a universal SA fix). Bench at molmetal/scripts/bench_sa_closure_bias_generation.py + report at molmetal/reports/wf139_p6_sa_closure_bias/. Total emissions 231 (pool-saturation ceiling; closure-BFS per-pocket reachable space ~6-22 unique candidates per pocket). 16/16 tests PASS at molmetal/tests/test_sa_closure_bias_generation.py.
